question: What mantra element is to be placed at the middle of the eyebrows?
premises: A mantra is to be placed at the middle of the eyebrows.
The ṭa-group is joined with bindu.
inference: One should place the mantra consisting of the ṭa-group with bindu at the middle of the eyebrows.
plain_english: One should place the mantra, the ṭa-group joined with bindu, at the middle of the eyebrows.
